title: Skeleton handoff
description: A publication preview uses a delayed, shape-matched placeholder for slower responses.
useCase: Avoid placeholder flashes on fast responses while keeping slower content spatially predictable.
interaction: Reload the publication and compare fast and slow responses.
reducedMotion: Placeholder and content swap instantly without fading; timing and layout remain stable.
limitations: Simulated local responses: 65 ms fast and 850 ms slow. The slow placeholder lasts 710 ms; this is not a general request cache or minimum-dwell abstraction.
look: Deep blue page with a publication card: pale sage cover with a big serif letter and arc beside a white two-line serif title.
motion: Reloading waits 140 ms before cross-fading to shape-matched placeholder blocks, so the 65 ms fast response skips them; the 850 ms response fades new content in over 0.2 s.
adapt: The handoff is two timers in the loading effect: `setSkeleton` after 140 ms and completion after 65 or 850 ms; `[data-skeleton=true]` swaps `.cover`/`.copy` for `.bones` by opacity. Replace the timers with your request lifecycle and reshape `bones` to your layout.
